name: Yame (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Yame city emblem in blue: an outlined pointed oval with wings enclosing a stylised numeral 9.
history: Municipal flag of Yame, a city in Fukuoka Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 18 March 1954.

features.role: Yame city emblem — an outlined pointed oval with wings enclosing a stylised numeral 9
